stages.blurb: The cheap end. Charmander is never a chase card, so this bar tends to move fastest. Not because we prioritise it, but because it costs the least.
The forgotten middle. Nobody collects Charmeleon on purpose, which makes it the quietest stretch of the run.
The wall. Every card here is somebody's grail, and 116 of the 207 sit in this one stage.
